messages.label: POST /v1/chat/completions
messages.note: One request carries the gateway transcript and tool list

messages.label: parseGatewayRequest
messages.note: Reads newest user content; strips notes; checks marker agreement

messages.label: turn, auxiliary, scheduled, or unmarked
messages.note: No tools means auxiliary fixed text; tools with no marker and no tag means NO_REPLY

messages.label: handle or handleScheduled
messages.note: Scheduled tags only count with no marker; identity comes from the row

messages.label: reply content
messages.note: Blank content becomes NO_REPLY; each attachment is one MEDIA line

messages.label: 200 JSON or SSE reply
messages.note: Assistant chunk, stop chunk, optional usage chunk, then DONE
